title: Policy-driven admin audit retention and escrow workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a policy-driven system for admin audit events (admin actions, access, config changes) that enforces customer-configurable data residency and retention rules, produces cryptographically verifiable WORM evidence bundles, and automates evidence/reporting exports to customer-defined escrow locations. This initiative covers product requirements, console UX, API surface, compliance documentation, and coordination with runtime and security teams for HSM/KMS stamping and tamper-evident manifests.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can set per-organization and per-region audit retention policies in the Console and via API (retention period, WORM-enabled toggle, escrow target, legal-hold override)

Audit events for admin actions, access grants/revokes, and config changes are captured with immutable metadata (actor, timestamp, region, request-id, prior-state-hash) and written to a WORM-backed storage path with tamper-evidence

Automated nightly evidence bundles are produced with a signed manifest (HSM/KMS) and pushed to customer-configured escrow endpoints (S3/GCS with signed URLs or partner escrow) with retry and backoff semantics
Console displays retention policy evaluation for a given event, shows residency constraints, and exposes an export audit trail for regulatory review
APIs return stable proof artifacts (manifest URL, signature, notarization timestamp) which can be used by customers or auditors to verify immutability
End-to-end tests validate that retention and legal-hold rules prevent deletion or rotation of evidence until allowed by policy and legal-hold release
tasks: Draft product PRD and policy model (per-org, per-region, fallback rules)
Define API schema for retention policy CRUD, escrow targets, and evidence requests
Console mocks for policy editor, retention diagnostics, and escrow status
Work with ENG runtime to add WORM output path and manifest signing hooks
Define HSM/KMS integration checklist and RBAC for signing keys
Implement export worker with retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and observable metrics
Create E2E test harness for retention/escrow workflows and legal-hold scenarios
Update compliance docs and create customer-facing runbook for escrow retrieval
decision_log: 2025-02-14: Decision to support both cloud escrow (S3/GCS) and partner escrow endpoints; local on-prem escrow to be scoped in follow-up
2025-02-16: Agreed to require HSM-backed key signing for production manifests; KMS-only acceptable for early-stage customers behind NDA
2025-02-18: Retention policy model will be hierarchical: org-level default, project-level override, event-type overrides, with explicit residency constraints
